title: Please Put Them On, Takamine-san
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Koushi Shirota learns that student council president Takane Takamine can rewind time by removing a piece of underwear, which then vanishes. Because he saw her naked he keeps his memories of each rewind, so she blackmails him into being her 'closet', supplying replacement underwear and keeping the secret. Their forced partnership slowly reveals her long-held feelings for him.
life_message: It holds up perfection-seeking giving way to honest affection, through a comedy of embarrassment.
